text:
Sam (new-hire): Hey team, starting today! Where's the canonical Notion spot for onboarding docs and the RFC template? A few pages I found are view-only. Who grants edit?

anya_peopleops: Welcome Sam! :tada: Company handbook = Notion > Company Home > Handbooks. Engineering-specific onboarding lives in the Eng space > Onboarding. For edit access we add folks to role-based groups (Engineering Editors) or approve individual requests. DM me your email if you want me to add you.

cleo_docs: If a page is view-only click 'Request access' and include a short reason. That creates a request ticket. If you add @cleo_docs in the comment I can expedite. Team Templates folder has the RFC/Postmortem/Runbook templates — copyable once you have edit rights.

jon_eng: One gotcha: pages under "Team Restricted" are blocked to non-members. If you need a copy of a restricted runbook to reference while ramping, request a view or copy. For anything code-adjacent tag me and I'll approve short-term access.

Sam (new-hire): Thanks! Email is sam@redwood.com. I mostly need to copy RFC Template and add a link to my ramp doc.

doc-bot: docs-requests 490 created for sam@redwood.com (requested by anya_peopleops). Link: https://notion.company/requests/490

cleo_docs: Approved DR-490, adding Sam to Engineering Editors. You should see invite in Notion in ~2 mins. Welcome aboard!

Sam (new-hire): Got it 10x. One more: preferred naming convention for personal ramp notes?

jon_eng: We use "first-last - ramp" for private notes and "first-last (team) - ramp" for team-shared. Put team-shared under Eng > Ramps and add a one-line summary at the top.

anya_peopleops: Added Sam to Editors and sent onboarding checklist DM. Ping here if anything else is blocked.
